set.body:
Outcome

Run a cross-family conformance court over the completed vertical slices.

Acceptance

- Both use the same AxisRef, Column, MeasurementFrame, ScientificPlanIdentity, ExecutionReceipt, and AnalysisResult definitions.
- Neither path has an alternate source, frame, failure, streaming, provenance, or result hierarchy.
- A common inspection API can describe both plans before execution.
- Public errors remain method-specific where scientifically necessary without forking the core shell.
set.title: P4.1: prove predictive and relational plans share one exact public shell
